FN-KH6N2UU-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 176
Committee: Economic Development and Tourism Sponsor: Representative Ben Robbins
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/20/2026
House Bill 176 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama
Department of Environmental Management to adopt rules for the beneficial reuse of foundry
sand by January 1, 2027.
Page 1
